data.body: Fixed: added 3 assertions to test_validate_exits_2_on_partial_tests in test-validate-test-batched-integration.sh verifying that VALIDATION_STATE_FILE (validate.sh status file) is written with 'pending' as first line, contains a test_state_file= line, and that the test_state_file path matches the expected value. Used WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env var to control and observe the exact artifacts directory path during the test.
